post.description: Step 1: turn free text into a suggested order the user reads back (start, or revise with `draft_id`).
Step 2: the user approved the suggestion /draft showed them. Locks that exact Mandate (by `version`).

With `draft_id`: run the confirmed, locked Mandate (never a re-parse; one-shot). With `text`: the original
free-text path, unchanged.

The user approves one card. The Brain's per-card verdict is binding here: a BLOCKED card (AI veto) is
refused, a BREAKOUT card always needs FaceID; only what has not already run automatically is executed, and
it goes through the shared MarketRouter (cross-chain tether radius, live vault or honest simulation).

post.description:
One PegGuard de-peg scan pass (only if `enabled == True` for `req.account`). PegGuard decides what is
profitable; the AI Brain decides what of it runs now, inside the soft tether and the cross-chain radius.
Registers a primary or backup hardware WebAuthn P-256 passkey on-chain/off-chain.
Revokes a specific device passkey while ensuring at least one passkey remains active.
Configures an Emergency Passkey Recovery Guardian for device-loss recovery.
Executes guardian-authorized passkey recovery when the user's primary device is lost.
Verifies a hardware WebAuthn P-256 assertion (enforcing UP + UV flags and s <= N/2) and opens the 5-minute grace window.

post.description:
The killswitch: the vault stops accepting anything from the Brain's session key.

Revoking removes every layer the key relies on: the account uninstalls it as an ERC-7579 executor (what
`TecAccount.execute` checks), the SessionKeyValidator deactivates it, and the hook drops its authorization.
Restoring re-provisions all three. Owner-only, local test chain only.
